### Prohorov's Theorem



:::{.theorem data-title="Prohorov's Theorem"}

Every sub-sequential limit is the distribution function of a
[[probability-measure|probability measure]] $\iff$ $\{  F_{n} \}$ is
[[tightness|tight]].

:::

`\begin{proof}`
For a proof see
[[files-notes-pstat213bc-lecture-notes-raya-pdf|PSTAT213BC Lecture Notes (Raya), page 42]].
`\end{proof}`
